statement: Add a `retries` keyword parameter to Session.request (default 0) that retries idempotent requests (GET/HEAD) up to N times on connection errors. Keep the style consistent with the file, document the parameter, and don't break existing tests.

Add a session-level `on_request` event hook that is invoked with the prepared Request object immediately before sending, mirroring the existing response hook mechanism (hooks list format and exception behavior). Document it alongside the existing hooks documentation.

Make per-request `verify=None` fall back to the session-level `verify` value in Session.request instead of always overriding it, while an explicitly passed verify still wins. Document the precedence rules in the docstring.
